utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll help get it finished.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late, but I can still help. Tell me what’s left and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, I’ve got a few things left on my list, and with you here we can finish them quickly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll bring the tools and check the wiring first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before you start, can you check the breaker panel too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I’ll check the breaker panel first, then the wiring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over some spare wire and tape if you still need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help a lot. I think I still need a couple things for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check my stash and bring over anything else you’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think the porch light is the first thing, but I need to check the wiring and the hinge too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Let's check the wiring first, then the hinge if the light still looks off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the porch light and a couple of loose steps were still on the list, but I may be missing a few details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know if there are any other items on the list besides the porch light and loose steps?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam again. Folks are saying the church lot’s where they’re gathering parts this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, and I think they’re still sorting tools by the side door. I’d swing by early if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve been telling everyone about it — come by and bring a friend if you can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll try to make it by and I’ll check the location again before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, it’s at the community hall on Maple near the park entrance — I’ll see you there if you make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Kira. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you really can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can. Tell me what needs doing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, so tell me which fix you want to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the front gate latch. I can swing by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll get the latch on the list and keep it ready for after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to folks as they ask.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan as people ask.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to check on that earlier, but I got distracted. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly the parts and a ladder, if you still have one. I can list it out for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can grab the parts list. I still might have a ladder in the shed, too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I can help spread the word about the repair drive and see who still needs details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules. I’ll point people your way if they need the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, I’ll make sure anyone who needs it gets the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, good timing - I’m telling everyone about the repair drive, and I’d love for you to come by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can stop by for that. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: How about 6:00? That gives people time to swing by after work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive's coming up. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll need a hand moving the heavier things and maybe a list of who can use a drill. I’ll write down the rest tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll help move the heavy things, and if you send me the drill list, I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate, but I need to know when the repair drive is happening so I can work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m aiming for Saturday morning, right after the school run. If that clashes, I can shift it a bit earlier or later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work if we keep it after the school run. Let me know the exact time and I’ll see if I need to adjust pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I can help round people up for the repair drive and make sure the right folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll help round folks up and make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Vik. I’ll let people know and we can split up the list so nobody gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a wrench you can borrow for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, but I’m worried about hauling and organizing everything. Do you think we’ve got enough space for the tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, we should keep it tight and stack the tools by the back wall so they’re easy to grab.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track where the repair drive is headed. Tell me the next stop and I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. Tell me the next stop and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Where should I bring the repair drive materials?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bring them to the community center entrance, and I’ll make sure they get sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll bring them there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the broken gate latch and a few loose porch boards. I’ve also got a short list of missing screws and one lamp that needs a bulb.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the gate latch and porch boards, and I’ll bring a handful of screws and a bulb too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening, but I'm still catching up on the details. What do you know so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it's a neighborhood repair drive for fixing up small stuff, but I missed the full details too. I should probably check who's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s still a bit fuzzy, but I’ll ask around too and see who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s on for sure. I heard they’re starting with the bigger fixes first, so it should actually make a dent.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, because I’m not taking anyone’s word for it until I see the crews show up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. I can swing by later if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I’m managing for now, but I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No rush at all. Let me know if anything changes, and I’ll check back later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I can help, if I don’t forget what I was just saying.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll keep track this time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I remember now. It’s mostly the loose panel by the front steps, and maybe that wobbly hinge if we’ve got time.
